description_en: Creates execution plans for batch scheduled prefetch tasks
description_zh: 制定批量新增定时预热任务的计划
kebab_example: aliyun esa create-scheduled-preload-executions --id 665d3af3621bccf3fe29e1a4 --executions SliceLen=10 EndTime=2024-06-04T02:02:09Z StartTime=2024-06-03T16:00:00Z Interval=30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateScheduledPreloadExecutions

parameters.help_en: The prefetch task ID, generated by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850459.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 预热任务ID，通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850459.html接口生成
parameters.name: id

fields.help_en: The start time of the scheduled prefetch plan, in ISO 8601 format (such as 2024-01-01T00:00:00+Z)
fields.help_zh: 定时预热计划开始时间，格式为 ISO 8601（如 2024-01-01T00:00:00+Z）
fields.name: start_time

fields.help_en: The end time of the scheduled prefetch plan, in ISO 8601 format (such as 2024-01-01T00:00:00+Z)
fields.help_zh: 定时预热计划结束时间，格式为 ISO 8601（如 2024-01-01T00:00:00+Z）
fields.name: end_time

fields.help_en: The interval between each batch execution of the scheduled prefetch plan, in seconds
fields.help_zh: 定时预热计划每批执行间隔，单位秒
fields.name: interval

fields.help_en: The number of URLs to prefetch per batch
fields.name: slice_len

parameters.help_en: The list of execution plans to be added for the scheduled prefetch task
parameters.help_zh: 待添加的定时预热任务执行计划列表
parameters.name: executions
